dialogues.speaker: Fengtai Advertisement
dialogues.text: Glazed pendants are in stock, with a small number of bracelets also now available. Supplies are limited, buyers make haste, else this opportunity you will waste!

dialogues.speaker: Beautiful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Hello, do you still have any of the jade Carp pendants I saw last time?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Sorry, those are sold out right now."

dialogues.speaker: Beautiful Handwriting
dialogues.text: "If I had known sooner, I would've bought it then... I wonder if the Carp Adeptus will be angry at me for this. I hope she'll protect Chaoxi and bring him back home as soon as possible..."
